name: Katekyo ~Akaruku Tanoshiku Koku Ecchi~
original_name: かてきょ ～明るく楽しく濃くエッチ～
source:
Main character wants a girlfriend. One day he receives a flyer promising to teach how to win a girl in just a week. He attends the course. Fun times begin now!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公想要一个女朋友。某天，他收到一张传单，上面声称能够教会他如何在短短1周内赢得女孩的芳心。他报名参加了这门课程。欢乐的时光从此开始！
